translationRepairs: 北平 was Beiping; it was renamed Beijing only in 1403.
He was repeatedly appointed assistant regional commander.
He was repeatedly appointed vice commissioner-in-chief.
都督同知 is vice commissioner-in-chief of a Chief Military Commission.

On entering the capital he rose in stages to left regional commander of the central command, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Wu'an with an income of fifteen hundred piculs, and granted a hereditary patent.

On entering the capital he rose in stages to left commissioner-in-chief of the Central Chief Military Commission, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Wu'an with an income of fifteen hundred piculs, and granted a hereditary patent.
中府左都督 is the left commissioner-in-chief of the Central Chief Military Commission.
He was promoted to vice commander of the Beijing metropolitan command.
He was promoted to vice regional military commissioner of Beiping.
北平都指揮僉事: Beiping regional military commission, and the city was not yet Beijing.
At Hulunbuir he was struck by a stray arrow while pursuing the enemy and fell back, then rejoined the main army and together they defeated the enemy.
At Khulgen (Hushiwen) he was struck by a stray arrow while pursuing the enemy and fell back, then rejoined the main army and together they defeated the enemy.
忽失溫 is Khulgen/Hushiwen, not Hulunbuir.
His wife was Lady Zhu, daughter of Duke of Cheng Chunchen.
His wife was Lady Zhu, daughter of Zhu Chunchen, Duke of Chengguo.
成國公 is the title Duke of Chengguo; the duke's surname was Zhu (朱純臣).
He rose in stages to metropolitan vice commander.
He rose in stages to vice commissioner-in-chief.
都督僉事 is vice commissioner-in-chief.
When the prince entered the capital his merit was assessed alongside the other battle generals, and he was promoted to metropolitan vice commander.
When the prince entered the capital his merit was assessed alongside the other battle generals, and he was promoted to vice commissioner-in-chief.
都督僉事 is vice commissioner-in-chief.
When Emperor Huidi had just taken the throne, ministers recommended Xin for strategy and courage, and he was transferred to the Beijing regional command.
When Emperor Huidi had just taken the throne, ministers recommended Xin for strategy and courage, and he was transferred to the Beiping regional military commission.
北平都司: the city was Beiping until 1403.
At the great review at Suining, Xin pleaded illness and did not attend; he was demoted to serve as a staff officer.
At the great review at Xining, Xin pleaded illness and did not attend; he was demoted to serve as a staff officer.
Zilong, whose courtesy name was Yanping, succeeded to the title at the age of fifteen.
His son Long, whose courtesy name was Yanping, succeeded to the title at the age of fifteen.
子隆 means 'his son Long'; 子 is not part of the name.
He rose in stages to metropolitan commander.
He rose in stages to regional military commissioner.
都指揮使 is regional military commissioner.
He followed in raising troops; through four years of campaigning he had merit in all of them and rose in stages to metropolitan commander.
He followed in raising troops; through four years of campaigning he had merit in all of them and rose in stages to regional military commissioner.
都指揮使 is regional military commissioner.
He rose in stages to metropolitan commander and was enfeoffed as Earl of Xiangcheng with an income of a thousand piculs.
He rose in stages to regional military commissioner and was enfeoffed as Earl of Xiangcheng with an income of a thousand piculs.
都指揮使 is regional military commissioner.
The regional military commission sought a descendant of the Earl of Xing'an; Liang then thanked his neighbors and left, and was appointed secretary at the Nanjing central command.
The Chief Military Commission sought a descendant of the Earl of Xing'an; Liang then thanked his neighbors and left, and was appointed secretary at the Nanjing central command.
都督府 is the Chief Military Commission.
He followed the founding emperor across the Yangzi, rose through the ranks to battalion commander of the Yanzhong Central Guard, and then retired.
He followed the founding emperor across the Yangzi, rose through the ranks to battalion commander of the Yan Mountain Central Guard, and then retired.
燕山中護衛 is the Yan Mountain Central Guard.
He rose in stages to metropolitan vice commander.
He rose in stages to vice commissioner-in-chief.
都督僉事 is vice commissioner-in-chief.

Fu and the others said that Metropolitan Vice Commander Li Bin's merit was not below that of Fang Kuan, that the sons of the Duke of Jing and Marquis of Jinxiang had not yet succeeded to their titles, and that Chen Xian, Zhang Xing, Chen Zhi, and Wang You had merit equal to Liu Cai and others.

Fu and the others said that Vice Commissioner-in-Chief Li Bin's merit was not below that of Fang Kuan, that the sons of the Duke of Jing and Marquis of Jinxiang had not yet succeeded to their titles, and that Chen Xian, Zhang Xing, Chen Zhi, and Wang You had merit equal to Liu Cai and others.
都督僉事 is vice commissioner-in-chief.
When the Yan army rose in Beijing, Sheng was the first to surrender Tongzhou.
When the Yan army rose in Beiping, Sheng was the first to surrender Tongzhou.
The Minister of War, Cheng Xin, served as supervising secretary of the expedition.
The Minister of War, Cheng Xin, supervised the expedition.
督之 means he supervised the campaign.
He rose from the ranks to become vice commander of the Yanshan Left Guard.
He rose from the ranks to become vice commander of the Yan Mountain Left Guard.
燕山左護衛 is the Yan Mountain Left Guard.
During the Hongwu reign he served as vice commander of the Yanzhong Central Guard.
During the Hongwu reign he served as vice commander of the Yan Mountain Central Guard.
燕山中護衛 is the Yan Mountain Central Guard.
By merit he should have been made a marquis, but because of arrogance and license he received only the post of metropolitan vice commander.
By merit he should have been made a marquis, but because of arrogance and license he received only the post of assistant regional military commissioner.
都指揮僉事 is assistant regional military commissioner.
When the Tümed raided, he drove them back.
When the Doyan raided, he drove them back.
朵顏 is the Doyan (Uriankhai) guard, not the Tümed.
He inherited his father's post as centurion of the Yan Guard.
He inherited his father's post as centurion of the Yan Mountain Guard.
燕山護衛 is the Yan Mountain Guard.
He proved too timid for combat and also fell out with the regional commander Fang Zheng.
He proved too timid for combat and also fell out with Chief Commissioner Fang Zheng.
